newsitem.title: USA: Los Angeles County plans Feb. certificates sale.
newsitem.headline: Los Angeles County plans Feb. certificates sale.

text.p: Los Angeles County, Calif., plans to sell about $80 million of certificates of participation in February to fund a new courthouse, a county finance official said on Monday.
Maureen Sicotte, the county's director of finance and investments, said the Series B certificates would be used to build a new courthouse near Los Angeles International Airport.
Lehman Brothers is expected to serve as lead underwriter on the deal. The county will again approach AMBAC Inc about providing the insurance, Sicotte said.
In November, the county sold about $60 million of Series A certificates of participation to fund juvenile hall improvements and a parking structure.
